lines.zh: 我在医院走廊里巡逻，鞋底粘着菌丝。
lines.en: I patrol the hospital corridor, spores stuck to my soles.

lines.zh: 实验室的门牌还挂着，字被菌斑吃了。
lines.en: The lab door sign still hangs, its letters eaten by mold.

lines.zh: 我沿着永冻前哨的铁轨慢慢走。
lines.en: I shuffle along the frozen outpost's rusted rails.

lines.zh: 零号地的警戒线，我抬脚就跨过去。
lines.en: I step over Groundzero's warning tape without slowing.

lines.zh: 防护服里的水晃荡，走路有咕噜声。
lines.en: Water sloshes inside my suit as I walk.

lines.zh: 我数着地砖走，一格也不肯错。
lines.en: I count the floor tiles and never miss one.

lines.zh: 病例夹夹在腋下，纸页全黏成一块。
lines.en: The chart under my arm has fused into one damp page.

lines.zh: 我绕过地上的培养皿，怕踩碎样本。
lines.en: I skirt the petri dishes, afraid to crush a sample.

lines.zh: 消毒灯灭了，我照旧走这条路线。
lines.en: The sterilizer lamps are dead; I keep the same route.

lines.zh: 我推着空推车，轮子吱呀作响。
lines.en: I push an empty gurney that squeals on its wheels.

lines.zh: 走廊尽头的应急灯把我照成绿色。
lines.en: The emergency light at the corridor's end paints me green.

lines.zh: 我踩过碎玻璃，脚上没一点感觉。
lines.en: I walk across broken glass and feel nothing.

lines.zh: 通风口吹来冷风，我的面罩起了雾。
lines.en: Cold air from the vent fogs my visor.

lines.zh: 我走到标本柜前，停住，再转身。
lines.en: I reach the specimen cabinet, stop, and turn back.

lines.zh: 我拖着脚走，鞋跟磨平了。
lines.en: I drag my feet. The heels are worn flat.

lines.zh: 我沿着警戒线走第三圈。
lines.en: I pace the cordon line a third time.

lines.zh: 我盯着培养皿，像在等它说话。
lines.en: I stare at the petri dish as if waiting for it to speak.

lines.zh: 面罩里呼出的气，把玻璃蒙白了。
lines.en: My breath fogs the inside of my visor.

lines.zh: 我抬手挠脖子，指尖碰到的是菌丝。
lines.en: I scratch my neck and my fingers find mycelium.

lines.zh: 我对着坏掉的终端敲了几下键。
lines.en: I tap a few keys on the dead terminal.

lines.zh: 我在记录本上写字，墨水早干了。
lines.en: I write in my notebook with long-dried ink.

lines.zh: 我数试管：一、二、三，少了一支。
lines.en: I count the vials: one, two, three, one missing.

lines.zh: 我歪头听通风管里的风声。
lines.en: I tilt my head toward the wind in the ducts.

lines.zh: 防护服袖口裂了，我捏了捏它。
lines.en: My suit cuff has split; I pinch it shut.

lines.zh: 我把手举到灯下，看皮肤下的纹路。
lines.en: I hold my hand to the lamp and study the lines beneath the skin.

lines.zh: 我靠在实验台边，一动不动。
lines.en: I lean against the lab bench and go still.

lines.zh: 我听见自己的心跳，慢得离谱。
lines.en: I hear my own heartbeat, absurdly slow.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔面罩内侧，尝到铁锈味。
lines.en: I lick the inside of my visor and taste rust.

lines.zh: 我在墙上找自己的名字，没找到。
lines.en: I search the wall for my name and find nothing.

lines.zh: 我把散落的报告一张张叠好。
lines.en: I stack the scattered reports one by one.

lines.zh: 我把面罩摘下一半，又戴回去。
lines.en: I pull the mask half off, then put it back.

lines.zh: 我看着窗外的菌毯，没说话。
lines.en: I look at the fungal mat outside and say nothing.

lines.zh: 你穿着完整的衣服，这让我想起从前。
lines.en: You wear intact clothes; that reminds me of before.

lines.zh: 我隔着面罩看你，慢慢眨了一次眼。
lines.en: I look at you through the visor and blink once, slowly.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸太急了，我在数次数。
lines.en: Your breathing is too fast; I am counting it.

lines.zh: 我记得给活人做检查的流程。
lines.en: I still remember the procedure for examining the living.

lines.zh: 我把你当成新送来的样本。
lines.en: I take you for a newly delivered specimen.

lines.zh: 我歪头，护目镜后的眼睛没有光。
lines.en: I tilt my head, no light behind the goggles.

lines.zh: 你身上没有菌斑，真干净。
lines.en: Not a single patch of mold on you. So clean.

lines.zh: 我举起三根手指，等你报数。
lines.en: I raise three fingers and wait for you to count.

lines.zh: 我指指你的手臂，又指指我的。
lines.en: I point at your arm, then at mine.

lines.zh: 你的体温我隔着两米都能感到。
lines.en: I feel your body heat from two meters away.

lines.zh: 我在你脸上找相同的症状。
lines.en: I search your face for the same symptoms.

lines.zh: 我点头，像确认一份旧档案。
lines.en: I nod, as if confirming an old file.

lines.zh: 护甲挡了大半，我只闷哼一声。
lines.en: The armor eats most of it; I only grunt.

lines.zh: 别打面罩，那是我唯一干净的地方。
lines.en: Not the visor; it is my only clean part.

lines.zh: 伤口不疼，我担心的是漏气。
lines.en: The wound does not hurt; the leak worries me.

lines.zh: 我退到实验台后面，按住肋部。
lines.en: I retreat behind the bench and press my ribs.

lines.zh: 血是暗绿色的，我早该习惯。
lines.en: The blood is dark green; I should be used to it.

lines.zh: 二十点生命，你打得掉几点？
lines.en: Twenty hit points. How many can you take?

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起感染那天的疼。
lines.en: This blow recalls the pain of the day I was infected.

lines.zh: 我咬着牙，面罩里全是雾。
lines.en: I grit my teeth and the visor fills with fog.

lines.zh: 你打断了我的记录，我很不高兴。
lines.en: You interrupted my notes. I am not pleased.

lines.zh: 疼是好事，说明我还活着。
lines.en: Pain is good; it means I am still alive.

lines.zh: 你手里那瓶药水，颜色像我最后一份样本。
lines.en: That potion in your hand has the color of my last sample.

lines.zh: 玻璃瓶，给我玻璃瓶，我要装点东西。
lines.en: A glass bottle. Give me a glass bottle; I need to collect something.

lines.zh: 我闻到酒精味，脚步自己就过去了。
lines.en: I smell alcohol and my feet move on their own.

lines.zh: 那支试管里还有液体吗？我看看。
lines.en: Is there still liquid in that vial? Let me see.

lines.zh: 你把样本举高，我就跟着抬头。
lines.en: You raise the sample; my head follows it up.

lines.zh: 红石粉的红色让我想起培养基。
lines.en: The red of that redstone dust looks like growth medium.

lines.zh: 我伸手讨要，手指在发抖。
lines.en: I hold out my hand and my fingers tremble.

lines.zh: 一块发酵蛛眼，能换我半天安静。
lines.en: One fermented spider eye buys you half a day of quiet.

lines.zh: 我追着你的背包走了三步才停。
lines.en: I follow your pack three steps before stopping.

lines.zh: 那瓶子封口了吗？我怕它洒。
lines.en: Is that bottle sealed? I worry it will spill.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西在发光，我需要它。
lines.en: What you hold is glowing, and I need it.

lines.zh: 我用防护服袖子擦手，准备接。
lines.en: I wipe my hands on my sleeve, ready to receive.

lines.zh: 你把东西放地上，退后，我就来拿。
lines.en: Set it down, step back, and I will come get it.

lines.zh: 我不抢，我只是离得越来越近。
lines.en: I will not snatch it; I only get closer and closer.

lines.zh: 你手里那支注射器，我认得。
lines.en: I know that syringe in your hand.

lines.zh: 把样本给我，我不追你。
lines.en: Give me the sample, and I will not chase you.

lines.zh: 别撞我，这套防护服裂了会漏。
lines.en: Do not shove me; a crack in this suit leaks.

lines.zh: 我被撞得退了半步，才站稳。
lines.en: The bump knocks me half a step back before I steady.

lines.zh: 六层护甲不是白穿的，我顶得住。
lines.en: Six layers of armor are not for show; I hold.

lines.zh: 你撞到我的采样箱了，小心点。
lines.en: You hit my sample case. Careful.

lines.zh: 玻璃面罩磕在你肩上，闷响一声。
lines.en: My visor knocks your shoulder with a dull thud.

lines.zh: 我身上有股消毒水味，呛到你了吧。
lines.en: I smell of disinfectant; it stings your nose, right?

lines.zh: 我不让路，这条走廊归我管。
lines.en: I will not step aside; this corridor is mine.

lines.zh: 你蹭掉了我袖口一片菌膜。
lines.en: You scraped a patch of film off my cuff.

lines.zh: 撞过来时，我的手臂硬得像管子。
lines.en: When you bump me, my arm feels hard as pipe.

lines.zh: 我们肩膀相碰，我的比你的凉。
lines.en: Our shoulders touch; mine is colder than yours.

lines.zh: 我们不拥抱，我们交换培养皿。
lines.en: We do not embrace; we exchange petri dishes.

lines.zh: 两只研究员在一起，只讨论菌株编号。
lines.en: Two researchers together only discuss strain numbers.

lines.zh: 我把孢子吹进通风管，那就是后代。
lines.en: I blow spores into the vent; that is our offspring.

lines.zh: 我们隔着面罩点头，算是结伴。
lines.en: We nod through our visors; that counts as pairing.

lines.zh: 她的防护服比我的旧，我看得出来。
lines.en: Her suit is older than mine; I can tell.

lines.zh: 我们一起守着那台坏掉的培养箱。
lines.en: We guard the broken incubator together.

lines.zh: 同类靠近时，菌丝会自己缠上去。
lines.en: When kin come close, the mycelium reaches out on its own.

lines.zh: 我们交换了一份记录，字都糊了。
lines.en: We trade a page of notes, all of it smeared.

lines.zh: 配对不需要语言，只需要同样的病。
lines.en: Pairing needs no words, only the same sickness.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，像两具空培养罐。
lines.en: We stand side by side like two empty culture jars.

lines.zh: 这个瓶子我捡走了，里面还有东西。
lines.en: I am taking this bottle; there is still something inside.

lines.zh: 地上那张纸，是我丢的记录。
lines.en: That paper on the floor is the record I lost.

lines.zh: 我弯腰很慢，护甲卡着腰。
lines.en: I bend slowly; the armor catches at my waist.

lines.zh: 捡到的样本要贴标签，我找笔。
lines.en: Found samples need labels; I look for a pen.

lines.zh: 我把东西塞进胸前口袋，拍了两下。
lines.en: I tuck it into my chest pocket and pat it twice.

lines.zh: 这枚菌块归我了，别伸手。
lines.en: This fungal clump is mine now. Hands off.

lines.zh: 我只捡和研究有关的东西。
lines.en: I only pick up things related to research.

lines.zh: 我拾起碎镜片，对着光照了照。
lines.en: I pick up a shard of mirror and hold it to the light.

lines.zh: 掉落的东西，我一件件摆整齐。
lines.en: I line up the dropped things one by one.

lines.zh: 我捡起你的东西，又放回原处。
lines.en: I pick up your thing and put it back where it was.

lines.zh: 你的症状不合格，我要处理掉。
lines.en: Your symptoms fail inspection; I must dispose of you.

lines.zh: 我抬手示意你停下，你不听。
lines.en: I raise a hand for you to stop; you do not.

lines.zh: 记录上写着：样本失控。
lines.en: The record says: specimen out of control.

lines.zh: 我把你圈进观察名单第一位。
lines.en: I move you to the top of the observation list.

lines.zh: 你走动的方式像健康个体，太可疑。
lines.en: You move like a healthy subject. Very suspicious.

lines.zh: 我锁上门之前，先看了你一眼。
lines.en: Before I lock the door, I glance at you once.

lines.zh: 你踩坏了培养皿，这个我记住了。
lines.en: You crushed the petri dish. I remember that.

lines.zh: 我慢慢靠近，像做一次例行采样。
lines.en: I approach slowly, like doing a routine sampling.

lines.zh: 别跑，检查只需要几秒。
lines.en: Do not run; the examination takes only seconds.

lines.zh: 我把你标成需要隔离的对象。
lines.en: I mark you as a subject requiring isolation.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，脚步和你的重合。
lines.en: I follow you, my steps landing with yours.

lines.zh: 我在等你停下，好看清你的脸。
lines.en: I wait for you to stop so I can see your face.

lines.zh: 你拐弯，我也拐弯，隔着十格。
lines.en: You turn; I turn too, ten blocks behind.

lines.zh: 我数你的心跳，越数越快。
lines.en: I count your heartbeats, and they keep speeding up.

lines.zh: 我的面罩反光，你还没发现我。
lines.en: My visor glints and you still have not noticed me.

lines.zh: 我把手术刀换到右手。
lines.en: I switch the scalpel to my right hand.

lines.zh: 你回头，我就停住不动。
lines.en: You look back and I freeze in place.

lines.zh: 观察期结束，接下来是采样。
lines.en: Observation is over; sampling comes next.

lines.zh: 我记得你走过的每一步。
lines.en: I remember every step you have taken.

lines.zh: 距离缩到三格，呼吸声都听得见。
lines.en: The gap closes to three blocks; I can hear you breathe.

lines.zh: 这一下按流程来，六点伤害。
lines.en: This strike follows procedure: six points of damage.

lines.zh: 我用手肘撞你，护甲垫着。
lines.en: I hit you with my elbow, padded by armor.

lines.zh: 我的拳头不重，但从不落空。
lines.en: My fist is not heavy, but it never misses.

lines.zh: 你退，我就再补一下。
lines.en: You retreat; I add one more hit.

lines.zh: 打你是为了取样，不是为了泄愤。
lines.en: I strike you to sample, not out of anger.

lines.zh: 手套上沾了你的血，我记下来。
lines.en: Your blood is on my glove; I note it down.

lines.zh: 我抬手时防护服吱了一声。
lines.en: My suit creaks when I raise my arm.

lines.zh: 一次没打够，我接着来第二次。
lines.en: One was not enough, so here comes the second.

lines.zh: 我打得很准，因为我看过太多解剖图。
lines.en: I hit precisely; I have seen too many anatomy charts.

lines.zh: 你挡得不错，可惜护甲差了我六点。
lines.en: Good block, but your armor is six points short of mine.

lines.zh: 刷怪笼亮了，我又回到这条走廊。
lines.en: The spawner lights up and I am back in this corridor.

lines.zh: 医院的地下室，我醒在病床边。
lines.en: In the hospital basement I wake beside a sickbed.

lines.zh: 永冻前哨的寒气先钻进面罩。
lines.en: The frozen outpost's cold reaches into my visor first.

lines.zh: Groundzero 的警报还在响。
lines.en: Groundzero's alarm is still going.

lines.zh: 我从笼子里走出来，关节咔咔响。
lines.en: I step out of the cage, joints cracking.

lines.zh: 灯管闪了三下，我就站在这里了。
lines.en: The tube flickered three times and here I stand.

lines.zh: 我醒来第一件事是找我的记录本。
lines.en: The first thing I do on waking is look for my notebook.

lines.zh: 实验室的地面很凉，我记得这个温度。
lines.en: The lab floor is cold; I remember this temperature.

lines.zh: 有人把笼子修好了，我又被放出来。
lines.en: Someone fixed the cage, so I am released again.

lines.zh: 我的面罩里还有上一轮的气息。
lines.en: My visor still holds the breath of the last round.

lines.zh: 火苗舔上来，面罩里全是焦味。
lines.en: Flames lick at me and the visor fills with the smell of burning.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下来，护甲先着地。
lines.en: I fall from a height and my armor lands first.

lines.zh: 水灌进面罩，我抓不住气了。
lines.en: Water floods my visor and I cannot catch a breath.

lines.zh: 冲击波把面罩掀歪了。
lines.en: The blast knocks my visor crooked.

lines.zh: 箭钉在护甲上，我懒得拔。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in my armor and I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 药水在我身上烧出一圈白痕。
lines.en: The potion burns a white ring into my suit.

lines.zh: 我不记得上次吃东西是什么时候。
lines.en: I cannot recall the last time I ate.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，防护服亮了一瞬。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my suit glows for an instant.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有空气，我连呼吸都省了。
lines.en: There is no air in the void, so I stop bothering to breathe.
